newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - August 27.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - August 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones fell by 28.85 to 5,693.89. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 5/8 to $59 1/8.
* The peso closed at 26.196 to a U.S. dollar from 26.209.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3210.30, down 16.16 on Monday.
* The average yield for the Phippines' 91-day treasury bill rate fell 12.029 percent from last week's 12.074.
* The Philippine overnight call loan rate rose to 11.71875 percent from 11.0625.
* Dharmala Securities Philippines advised investors to accumulate interest-sensitive property stocks. Analyst Erwin Balita said Fil-Estate and Empire East Land Holdings are good buys.
- Philippine Daily Inquirer says PDCP Bank is offering one billion pesos in preferred shares.

- Manila Standard says the Securities and Exchange Commission will decide on Tuesday whether or not officials of Dizon Copper and Silver Mines can renege on a voluntary commitment to refrain from implementing several controversial resolutions passed by the company's board of directors.
- Manila Bulletin says Alcorn Philippines Inc and Basic Petroleum and Minerals Corp have both won new exploration contracts from the Department of Energy.
